description: Local-first hybrid model routing toolkit. The Tierkit runtime starts automatically; the sidebar lets you run tasks, drive workflow sessions, classify commands, and watch usage.
viewContainer.title: Tierkit
view.dashboard.name: Dashboard
configuration.title: Tierkit
configuration.baseUrl: Base URL of the Tierkit runtime daemon. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:4101. The extension auto-starts a daemon at this URL when activated (unless tierkit.autoStartDaemon is false).
configuration.statusBar: Show a Tierkit status bar item with daemon health.
configuration.autoStartDaemon: Automatically start the Tierkit runtime daemon in-process when the extension activates. Set to false if you prefer to run `tierkit runtime start` yourself in a terminal.
